{{dablink|For other uses of the word "crystal," see [[Crystal]].}}

The '''crystal vial''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|2}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is a tiny, stoppered vial made of what appears to be crystal. It contains a dark red liquid inside.{{ref/book|8|2}}

==Use==
The use of this ''ter'angreal'' is unknown. Judging by its appearance, however, it may be similar to a ''[[cour'souvra]]''.
